2126280084596072856.en_summary: #designoftheday Designed by Finnish designer Eero Aarnio, the Ball Chair challenged conventional notions of seating. Its sculptural fiberglass shell, upholstered interior & swiveling base create an intimate retreat from surrounding activity. Introduced at the 1966 Cologne Furniture Fair, it became an icon of Space Age design.
2126280084596072856.zh_summary: #designoftheday 由芬蘭設計師Eero Aarnio設計的球椅挑戰了傳統的座位概念。其雕塑般的玻璃纖維外殼、軟墊內部和旋轉底座創造了一個遠離周圍活動的私密空間。於1966年科隆家具博覽會推出，成為太空時代設計的標誌。
